name: Hotel Le Fontanelle
positioning: Manor house hotel deep in the heart of Chianti, on the Vallepicciola wine estate
best_for: Couples, families and groups of friends wanting a Chianti countryside base
Wine lovers who want to tour the estate's vineyards and cellar

facts.text: Hotel Le Fontanelle is a manor house deep in the heart of Chianti.
The estate transformed old farmhouses into intimate, modern spaces.
The hotel caters to couples, families, groups of colleagues and friends.
Guests have free use of a panoramic swimming pool, mountain bikes, petanque, a heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, Turkish bath, Jacuzzi and relaxing area.
Classic Rooms have terracotta floors and oak-beamed ceilings.
Deluxe Rooms have a private lounge area and views.
Junior Suites are surrounded by vineyards and olive groves of the Sienese countryside.
La Colonna restaurant reinterprets Italian cuisine, with windows all around the restaurant offering views.
Guests can visit the Vallepicciola winery of the Bolfo family, with a biodiverse vineyard, woods, meadow and small lake.
Activities include hot air balloon flights, horseback riding, petanque, Vespa outings, e-bike rides and picnics.

highlights.text: The Health Club includes an indoor heated pool, relaxation area, fitness room, sauna, Turkish bath, jacuzzi and private massage room, with free access reserved for Hotel Le Fontanelle guests.
Wine tours visit the vineyards and the barrel room of the modern Vallepicciola cellar.
Suites have a living room and a large private garden.
Prestige Rooms have a small private garden.

considerations.text: Hotel Le Fontanelle shares its estate with a sister hotel, The Club House.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a car for accessing nearby attractions.
